{{Quote|This factory builds helper droids. These are the most evil droids ever known to the galaxy.|[[Draykken Bender]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RAL" />}}
A '''droid factory''' manufacturing helper [[Droid/Legends|droids]] was located on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
{{Quote|I simply cannot wait another minute. We must be going soon, R2. Those helper droids, quite frankly, send a shiver down my circuits.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], to [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]]|<ref name="SWG:TTLF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Those Things Last Forever|Corellia}}</ref>}}
[[File:QU3-3N_Helper.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[QU3-3N]] alongside a smaller helper droid.]]
The droid factory was located in an isolated area of [[Bindreg Hills|forested hills]] on the planet Corellia. The factory produced helper droids, variants of [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] which would give people repetitive advice on their respective professions. The manufacturing operations were oversaw by the droid [[QU3-3N]].<ref name="SWG:RAL" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the droid factory was targeted by [[Draykken Bender]], a leader of the [[Meatlumps]], a group technology-hating [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorists]]. Draykken and [[Hraykken Bender]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with attacking the factory to destroy as much helper droids as possible. The spacer therefore fought and destroyed most helper droids in the droid factory, including QU3-3N.<ref name="SWG:RAL" />

Around the same time, the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] also moved to the droid factory in order to study the programming of the helper droids. C-3PO requested a spacer to retrieve several droid interfaces for further analysis.<ref name="SWG:TTLF" />

==Behind the scenes==
The helper droid factory was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RAL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The helper droid factory was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 10|Game Update 10]]," released on [[June 2]], [[2009]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=927421|text=Star Wars Galaxies: Game Update 10}}</ref>
